europe_now.title: Pope Leo XIV Begins State Visit to France
europe_now.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived in France for a four-day state visit, holding discussions with President Emmanuel Macron at the Élysée Palace and focusing international attention on topics including peace and human dignity.

sources.headline: Pope Leo visits France: Pontiff wants to focus world's attention on peace, human dignity, technology
Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit

europe_now.title: Italy Introduces New Restrictions in Schools
europe_now.summary: Italian authorities announced a ban on the burqa in schools alongside measures to limit the proportion of foreign pupils. The policy changes have drawn attention to evolving integration and security debates within Southern Europe.

sources.headline: Italy to ban burqa in schools, limit foreign pupils

top_stories.title: Papal Diplomacy in Paris
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has commenced a multi-day visit to France, marking his first state visit to the country in nearly two decades. French President Emmanuel Macron hosted the pontiff at the Élysée Palace amidst extensive public security deployments.

sources.headline: France: Pope Leo XIV welcomed by Macron at the Élysée
Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit

top_stories.title: European Artificial Intelligence Policy Debates
top_stories.summary: European officials and advisors continue to spar over the implementation and enforcement of the bloc's artificial intelligence regulations. Critics have raised concerns regarding the European Commission's current response mechanisms to frontier technologies.

sources.headline: Von der Leyen ally slams EU Commission’s AI response
